evidence.title: Police routinely failing to investigate ‘revenge porn’ in England and Wales

occurrences.checkable_against: the dataset of reported image-based abuse images cited by the research
occurrences.quote_span: Image-based abuse overwhelmingly affects women and girls, who make up 98.9% of reported images.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Police handling of image-based abuse complaints in England and Wales

occurrences.checkable_against: Revenge Porn Helpline referral records from 2015 and 2025
occurrences.quote_span: Referrals to the Revenge Porn helpline, the charity that helps victims get non-consensual images removed from the internet, increased by more than 4,000% between 2015 and 2025, but data from 39 police forces in England and Wales shows that charges were lodged against perpetrators in an average of just 4.5% of cases last year.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Police handling of image-based abuse complaints in England and Wales

occurrences.checkable_against: the research and briefing by Leigh Day, the Centre for Women’s Justice and #NotYourPorn on AI-enabled image-based abuse
occurrences.quote_span: They note that rapid innovations in AI are helping abusers find new ways to create and disseminate synthetic explicit material, sometimes known as deepfake content.
occurrences.speaker: Leigh Day, the Centre for Women’s Justice and #NotYourPorn
occurrences.subject: Police handling of image-based abuse complaints in England and Wales

occurrences.checkable_against: the survivor interview or account collected in the research
occurrences.quote_span: “It felt like to them it wasn’t a priority, it wasn’t even a crime,” one woman told researchers.
occurrences.speaker: a woman quoted in the research
occurrences.subject: Police handling of image-based abuse complaints in England and Wales

occurrences.checkable_against: the filed police super-complaint and underlying image-based abuse case records
occurrences.quote_span: “The unavoidable conclusion is that the overwhelming majority of this offending goes unaddressed.”
occurrences.speaker: the super-complaint
occurrences.subject: Police handling of image-based abuse complaints in England and Wales

occurrences.checkable_against: the super-complaint and accompanying research by Leigh Day, the Centre for Women’s Justice and #NotYourPorn
occurrences.quote_span: Lawyers from Leigh Day and the charity the Centre for Women’s Justice are working with the charity #NotYourPorn to highlight systemic police failings in responding to image-based abuse, defined as “the taking, sharing or creating of intimate content without the survivor’s consent, or threatening to do so”.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Police handling of image-based abuse complaints in England and Wales

occurrences.checkable_against: the researchers' collected survivor accounts and police complaint records
occurrences.quote_span: Some police officers responded inappropriately when women tried to register complaints, researchers found.
occurrences.speaker: the researchers
occurrences.subject: Police handling of image-based abuse complaints in England and Wales

occurrences.checkable_against: the research findings and Keir Starmer's statement about image-based abuse
occurrences.quote_span: Their research suggests that image-based abuse is still frequently dismissed or not recognised as criminal offending, despite being described by the former prime minister Keir Starmer as a national emergency.
occurrences.speaker: the researchers
occurrences.subject: Police handling of image-based abuse complaints in England and Wales

occurrences.checkable_against: College of Policing and Independent Office for Police Conduct records on the super-complaint
occurrences.quote_span: The complaint will be jointly considered by the College of Policing and the Independent Office for Police Conduct, which will decide whether to respond by opening a wider investigation.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Police handling of image-based abuse complaints in England and Wales

occurrences.checkable_against: image-based abuse charging data from individual police forces in England and Wales
occurrences.quote_span: In some forces the figure was lower than 1%.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Police handling of image-based abuse complaints in England and Wales

occurrences.checkable_against: the survivor account collected in the research
occurrences.quote_span: while another said the officer responded: “Boys will be boys.”
occurrences.speaker: a woman quoted in the research
occurrences.subject: Police handling of image-based abuse complaints in England and Wales

occurrences.checkable_against: Home Office image-based abuse charging statistics for 2025/2026
occurrences.quote_span: Home Office data shows that there were only 569 charges issued for image-based abuse in 2025/2026.
occurrences.speaker: Home Office
occurrences.subject: Police handling of image-based abuse complaints in England and Wales

occurrences.checkable_against: the report's case studies and police investigation records
occurrences.quote_span: Police outsourced the evidence-gathering process to survivors in many cases, the report notes, leaving them to work out how to collate proof that the images were being disseminated widely and how to get the content removed from the internet.
occurrences.speaker: the report
occurrences.subject: Police handling of image-based abuse complaints in England and Wales

occurrences.checkable_against: the research report assessing the policing response to image-based abuse
occurrences.quote_span: Their research classifies the policing response as “fragmented, inconsistent and incapable of meeting the scale of the threat posed by image-based abuse”.
occurrences.speaker: the researchers
occurrences.subject: Police handling of image-based abuse complaints in England and Wales

occurrences.checkable_against: the research survey or interviews with survivors of image-based abuse
occurrences.quote_span: Researchers found that the vast majority of survivors of image-based abuse did not report it to the police, noting that “embarrassment, shame and fear” contributed to their reluctance.
occurrences.speaker: the researchers
occurrences.subject: Police handling of image-based abuse complaints in England and Wales

occurrences.checkable_against: the research and super-complaint on police handling of image-based abuse
occurrences.quote_span: Police forces are routinely failing to investigate complaints about the circulation of image-based abuse, previously known as “revenge pornography”, according to research that has triggered a super-complaint over the way such crimes are handled.
occurrences.speaker: the research cited by The Guardian
occurrences.subject: Police handling of image-based abuse complaints in England and Wales

occurrences.checkable_against: image-based abuse charging data from 39 police forces in England and Wales
occurrences.quote_span: data from 39 police forces in England and Wales shows that charges were lodged against perpetrators in an average of just 4.5% of cases last year.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Police handling of image-based abuse complaints in England and Wales

occurrences.checkable_against: Harriet Bland's statement and subsequent police guidance, training and national strategy records
occurrences.quote_span: Without an urgent overhaul of police guidance and training on image-based abuse – which must be regularly updated – and a clear national strategy rolled out across forces, survivors will continue to be let down.
occurrences.speaker: Harriet Bland
occurrences.subject: Police handling of image-based abuse complaints in England and Wales

occurrences.checkable_against: the survivor account collected in the research
occurrences.quote_span: One reported that the officer “almost giggled on the phone to me”
occurrences.speaker: a woman quoted in the research
occurrences.subject: Police handling of image-based abuse complaints in England and Wales

occurrences.checkable_against: the survivor interview or account collected in the research
occurrences.quote_span: Another said: “Police involvement has not alleviated the harm caused by this offence. Instead, it has intensified my distress and left me feeling powerless and completely unsupported as a victim.”
occurrences.speaker: a woman quoted in the research
occurrences.subject: Police handling of image-based abuse complaints in England and Wales

occurrences.checkable_against: the filed police super-complaint and charging, prosecution and conviction statistics
occurrences.quote_span: “Despite the increased public awareness, and the creation of new criminal offences designed to address this conduct, there has been no corresponding increase in charging rates, prosecutions or convictions,” the complaint says.
occurrences.speaker: the super-complaint
occurrences.subject: Police handling of image-based abuse complaints in England and Wales

occurrences.checkable_against: the statutory and regulatory record establishing police super-complaints in 2018
occurrences.quote_span: A police super-complaint is a mechanism introduced in 2018 to allow concerns to be raised about ways in which the police operate that may significantly harm the interests of the public generally, rather than focusing on an individual force of officer.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Police handling of image-based abuse complaints in England and Wales

occurrences.checkable_against: the research evidence gathered by Leigh Day, the Centre for Women’s Justice and #NotYourPorn
occurrences.quote_span: Lawyers have gathered evidence from 100 people who reported intimate images being shared online without their consent.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Police handling of image-based abuse complaints in England and Wales

occurrences.checkable_against: Revenge Porn Helpline report records for 2025
occurrences.quote_span: The Revenge Porn Helpline received almost 25,000 reports in 2025.
occurrences.speaker: Revenge Porn Helpline
occurrences.subject: Police handling of image-based abuse complaints in England and Wales
